Params: {1: '1', 3: 'A radiant golden clock rises slowly into the air. Streams of light pierce the darkness, tearing the rotting web of nightmares to shreds.'}
{3: "The Dream Master desperately summons more nightmares to halt the girl's advance, only to realize that at some point, the lambs under her control have slipped from her grasp."}
{1: '1', 2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'H-How can this be? The peace I granted them was supposed to be absolute...', 4: '18'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'Why... How are you able to return from that despair completely unscathed?!', 4: '18'}
{3: "Another searing bullet grazes past <phonetic=The Oneiros's>  her  <phonetic> hair. Kurumi pauses her assault briefly, an amused smile playing on her lips."}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'Oh? Is that how you see it?', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "Though I suppose it's understandable. After all, we're just a baby awakened machine who's barely three months old. How could we possibly understand human emotions?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "If anything, why didn't you ever notice the contradiction?", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The girl smiles as she unveils the world <phonetic=The Oneiros>  she  </phonetic> created with her own hands, yet never truly understood.'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'According to you, humans would turn into Nightmares the moment they choose despair...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'In that case, why does your control over the Dream Realm weaken whenever more Nightmares appear in the Deep Dream?', 4: '1'}
{3: '<phonetic=The Oneiros>  She  </phonetic> roars, her composure completely shattered.'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'I never forced them! From the very beginning, they were the ones who chose to enter the dream and willingly stayed in this world!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'If they can still turn into Nightmares even in a flawless paradise, it only proves their weakness. They brought this upon themselves!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Like a child refusing to admit her mistake, <phonetic=The Oneiros>  she  </phonetic> continues frantically spawning more nests, converting even more sleeping humans into Nightmares.'}
{3: 'The newborn nightmares tear through their cocoons of black mud, heads blooming like Venus flytraps as they charge forward with hoarse shrieks.'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "Sigh... You'd still act this stubborn, even after I spelled it out for you...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "If you insist on dragging everyone in this dream down with you, then don't blame me for what happens next.", 4: '1'}
{3: "The cylinder spins, a round gets chambered. Killing intent spills from the girl's left eye."}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "Listen carefully. The emotion that forms these nightmares isn't human despair at all—", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "It's their obsession with escaping this dream, their desperate will to break free from these lies.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: "She should have forgotten by now, but the cries of that unremarkable young man named Xi echo inexplicably within the Dream Master's hollow heart."}
{3: '"I want to go back," "Please, I\'m begging you," "I miss my home so much"...'}

{1: '1', 3: 'His voice joins the countless others she once heard but deliberately chose to ignore, and together, they close around her throat like innumerable hands, choking her, not giving her a chance to even deny.'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'You wanted to know what power I gained from that "nightmare," right? The answer is very simple.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "I've never killed a single Nightmare. I simply sent them back to the past and gave them another chance to choose.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'She finally falters under this relentless barrage of questions, her movements becoming slack in an instant.'}
{3: 'At that same time, an unprecedented, shrill, and rapid alarm erupts from your terminal.'}
{3: "The screen finally lights up stably for the first time, and immediately after, Lucia's voice cuts through all the interference with perfect clarity—"}
{1: '1', 2: "Lucia's Voice", 3: 'Commandant, we locked onto your position!', 4: '11'}
{2: "Lucia's Voice", 3: 'M.I.N.D. connection almost established. Counting down, 10, 9—', 4: '11'}
{1: '1', 3: "Kurumi raises her pistol, the second hand ticking within her golden left eye gradually synchronizing with Lucia's voice, second by second."}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "All the answers have been laid bare. Now then, playtime's over.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The Pyro Katana tears through the veil of the dream, and a gentle, blazing light pours in from the world beyond.'}
{3: "Lucia's form burns bright, like living flame itself, shattering the darkness that has loomed over you all."}
{2: 'Lucia', 3: 'Mind Beacon connection with Commandant established, combat zone confirmed!'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lee', 3: 'Affirmative. This is a collective consciousness prison induced by a "Spacequake." Combat designation: Dream City.', 4: '18'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: 'Detecting massive quantities of human consciousness held captive by unknown machinery. Currently confirming extraction protocols...', 4: '18'}

{2: 'Liv', 3: 'From this moment on, the individual codenamed "Oneiros" will be unable to interfere with the trapped consciousness. Once this prison collapses, everyone will safely return to their bodies.', 4: '18'}
{2: 'Lucia', 3: 'Copy that. Combat restrictions lifted. We can engage at full strength.'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "So these are the companions you've been searching for... I see now.", 4: '18'}
{3: 'A knowing smile plays on the lips of the girl in red.'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "This might be our first time meeting, but your trust in me is well-received. Let's do this together."}
{3: "Lucia and Kurumi's eyes meet across the space between them. No words are needed. The two of them give the slightest of nods."}
{2: 'Lucia', 3: '指挥官，请对我们下达作战指令!'}
{2: 'Gray Raven, coordinate with our ally<//Kurumi Tokisaki>—', 3: '214'}
{2: 'Defeat The Oneiros and bring everyone back to reality!', 3: '215'}
